title: Solver-Floor Continuation for Causal High-Frequency PINNs in 2D VO2 Devices
hook: A 2D VO2 PINN may not need a new spectral operator: at equal parameter, solver-data, collocation, and optimizer-update budgets, replacing the fixed global residual sum with a single-coordinate solver-floor continuation should recover event order and moving-front topology more faithfully.
hook_shape_rationale: Shape (c), counter-intuitive minimalism, passes because the candidate is capped at the strongest matched-budget baseline's parameter count, numerical-solver data, collocation points, and optimizer updates while changing only the objective-refinement path. Shape (a) was viable, but rejected because no supplied pilot establishes a surprising regime split before the proposed falsification run.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes whether a 2D-or-higher PCM PINN can keep the electric, Joule-heating, thermal, and phase-kinetic residuals simultaneously accurate when a pulse creates moving fronts and new high-frequency modes after the initial condition 鈥?stakes: device researchers can accept the wrong switching time, programming energy, or phase topology despite a small aggregate loss, wasting compute and misdirecting device design.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by replacing the inherited fixed aggregate-loss endpoint with a one-coordinate continuation toward simultaneous solver-floor residual feasibility; corpus support is thin for PCM PINNs, and the closest C23 exemplars redesign distant iterative refinement chains.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf tests whether one globally aggregated space-time objective over all coupled fields and switching regimes is necessary rather than assumed 鈥?stakes: if this shared assumption hides a fast local residual beneath slow-field averages, published accuracy conclusions can rest on the wrong certificate and principled high-frequency PINN design remains blocked.
gap_closure.how_closed: The C01 locus pivot moves the certificate from scalar aggregate loss to the continuation closure margin, while the companion ships a matched-budget, independent-solver intervention test; corpus support is thin because C01 exemplars are mainly security and detection locus shifts.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes that event order, front topology, and energy balance remain correct for held-out entire device geometries, material combinations, and pulse protocols that shift the spectrum and stiffness beyond training 鈥?stakes: reported gains may not transfer across devices or operating regimes, making the scientific conclusion non-general and the model unsafe as a design surrogate.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by locking the trained method before matched whole-entity geometry, material-stiffness, and pulse-spectrum interventions are scored by an independent FEniCSx oracle under the same Front-Energy-Causality framework.

core_mechanism: The shared_evaluation object is the Front-Energy-Causality framework, which reports dimensionless electric, Joule-constitutive, thermal, phase-kinetic, and initial/boundary residual errors together with switching-time error, programming-energy error, event-order violations, and phase-front topology error against an independent FEniCSx trajectory. A parameter-matched PINN outputs electric potential phi, temperature T, and phase fraction xi on a two-dimensional VO2 device; current density and Joule heating are computed as j=-sigma(T,xi) grad(phi) and q_J=sigma(T,xi)|grad(phi)|^2, and automatic differentiation supplies the coupled PDE and constitutive residuals r_b for every block b. Each ell_b is the mean squared r_b divided by a_b^2, where a_b is the root-mean-square magnitude of the corresponding FEniCSx PDE term on training entities, so blocks with different units become comparable without a hidden bridge weight. For each block, epsilon_b^F is the observed discretization-convergence floor from the two finest available FEniCSx mesh/time resolutions on training entities, epsilon_b(0)=max(ell_b(theta_0),epsilon_b^F) at the common initialization theta_0, and epsilon_b(s)=epsilon_b(0)^(1-s) epsilon_b^F^s for the single intervention coordinate s in [0,1]. Training minimizes L_s=sum_b [max(ell_b/epsilon_b(s)-1,0)]^2 and advances s by bisection only when the continuation closure margin M(s)=1-max_b ell_b/epsilon_b(s) is nonnegative on both training collocation and held-out validation entities; delta_s=0.02 is the bisection tolerance, swept over 0.01 to 0.05 for validation stability, and rho=1 is the dimensionless overall penalty scale, swept over 0.5, 1, and 2. M(s) is the sole load-bearing variable: it replaces a small global average with an auditable simultaneous-feasibility certificate, while the network, PDEs, samples, and optimizer remain unchanged. The assumption-audit companion compares this path against the same backbone trained with a globally normalized residual sum at equal updates and records cases with similar aggregate loss but divergent M(s), then asks whether the independent FEniCSx event, topology, and energy errors diverge in the predicted direction. After every design choice is frozen without formal-OOD entities, the same framework evaluates matched pairs that independently change geometry, VO2 material-stiffness parameters, or pulse spectrum, followed by a joint whole-entity OOD split; this is an evaluation of the one mechanism, not a second learned module. All claims are conditional on the declared synthetic FEniCSx electro-thermal-phase model, and no removal bound, Hessian guarantee, real-device validation, or global PINN guarantee is claimed.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 - PREMISES
Premise: pulse-driven VO2 dynamics couple electric conduction, Joule heating, thermal transport, and phase kinetics strongly enough that a small average residual can coexist with one failed physical block; the retrieved PCM and PINN evidence makes this physically plausible.
Premise: mesh/time-refined FEniCSx trajectories provide a usable numerical reference and blockwise discretization floors for the declared synthetic model; this is believed because convergence is checked within the same solver formulation rather than inferred from the PINN.
Observation-model premise: training and validation signals are sampled as complete FEniCSx whole-device trajectories with entity-grouped geometry, material, and protocol splits plus stratified space-time collocation; they are complete only for the declared synthetic design distribution, formal-OOD entities never tune the path, and no experimental-population representativeness is assumed.
Premise: M(s) predicts causal device fidelity better than an equally small global residual sum - untested - falsification target.
ESTIMAND: the paired difference, over the predeclared population of synthetic 2D VO2 device entities and pulse trajectories, in switching-time, programming-energy, event-order, phase-front-topology, and worst-block normalized-residual errors between solver-floor continuation and equal-budget baselines, plus the corresponding difference under each matched OOD intervention.
BLOCK 2 - NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT
Branch (i): the runnable naive version sets every block directly to its final solver-floor constraint at s=1 and optimizes from theta_0, but it silently assumes that a stiff, feedback-coupled electric-to-Joule-to-thermal-to-phase system can enter all tight residual basins simultaneously from initialization; that premise is false in the target setting, so the contribution confronts it with a single physically shared continuation coordinate and does not add cosmetic weights, packets, local heads, or a new operator. Continuation and constrained penalties are standard tools, but this instance is not exhausted by the textbook recipe because the terminal tolerances are solver-discretization floors for mutually endogenous PDE/constitutive blocks and must remain identifiable under one fixed update budget and a moving-front causal evaluation.
BLOCK 3 - DESIGN RATIONALE
The three gaps share one mechanism and one measurement object: the anchor creates M(s), the assumption audit tests whether it carries information hidden by aggregate loss, and whole-entity OOD probes the same locked object rather than adding a model branch. I rejected learned field-frequency partitioning plus local operators because it recreates an unidentifiable decomposition/operator composition, and rejected global Fourier enrichment, causal time weighting, XPINN partitioning, weak residuals, learned residual weights, and solver-embedded stepping because the method lineage already occupies those sources. I also rejected direct s=1 feasibility because it is the naive failure case and rejected any Taylor/Hessian removal bound because the available evidence does not price a safe same-coordinate path-Hessian envelope.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Use FEniCSx to solve the declared two-dimensional VO2 electric-thermal-phase PDE for complete device entities, perform the existing mesh/time refinement, and emit grouped training, validation, and untouched formal-OOD trajectories plus convergence-floor metadata.
2. Implement one parameter-capped PINN backbone that outputs phi, T, and xi; use the same initialization, collocation set, optimizer, and update budget for solver-floor continuation and every matched-backbone baseline.
3. Compute j, q_J, all PDE/constitutive/initial/boundary residual blocks, the training-only scales a_b, the converged floors epsilon_b^F, and the initial endpoint epsilon_b(0); emit a versioned residual-definition table consumed unchanged by every arm.
4. Train the equal-budget global-sum arm and the predeclared strong baselines, including Fourier-feature/adaptive PINN, causal PINN, and NeuSA where its published code supports the declared boundary conditions; emit checkpoints and Front-Energy-Causality metrics without using formal-OOD entities.
5. Train the continuation arm by evaluating L_s and M(s), updating the same network parameters, and moving s forward by the declared bisection rule only after training and validation feasibility; the changed s alters the next parameter update and therefore the predicted phi, T, xi, switching event, front, and energy.
6. At matched update checkpoints, pair continuation and global-sum models with similar aggregate loss and evaluate both through the independent FEniCSx oracle; emit the divergence between M(s) and downstream event, topology, energy, and worst-block residual errors.
7. Run the negative control by permuting the residual-block identities attached to epsilon_b(s) at every unchanged value of the same coordinate s while preserving architecture, endpoints, collocation, and update budget; retraining propagates the wrong feasibility path into phi, T, and xi and tests whether downstream errors return toward the global-sum arm.
8. Freeze architecture, scales, floors, rho, delta_s, and the final checkpoint, then evaluate matched whole-entity pairs that vary one of geometry, material stiffness, or pulse spectrum and finally the joint formal-OOD split; emit oracle-scored event order, topology, energy, and residual metrics.
9. Report paired-seed estimates, wall time, peak memory, solver preprocessing cost, all failed continuation stages, and synthetic-model scope, with no real-device or guarantee-grade claim.
falsification_prediction: The minimal experiment trains the continuation PINN, the equal-budget global-sum backbone, Fourier/adaptive and causal PINNs, and NeuSA on entity-grouped FEniCSx trajectories for a bounded two-dimensional VO2 device campaign, then measures worst-block normalized residual, switching-time error, programming-energy error, event-order violations, and phase-front topology error. If the candidate works, those downstream errors decrease for the continuation arm at the same parameter, collocation, solver-data, and update budgets, including on the locked whole-entity OOD split. The named load-bearing variable is M(s), and the negative control permutes residual identities along the unchanged s-coordinate and epsilon schedule; the mechanism predicts that event, topology, energy, and worst-block errors move back toward the global-sum baseline rather than merely changing M(s). Failure to outperform the matched global arm, or persistence of the downstream gain under the permutation control, falsifies the proposed continuation mechanism.
compute_budget: Estimated full falsification campaign: 8.0 80GB-class GPU-days on one GPU plus $0 paid API, with FEniCSx generation and refinement run on existing local CPU resources; this is tight but inside the user's 10 GPU-day envelope and includes iteration, matched baselines, controls, and three-seed replication.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: Abstract-only inference: NeuSA constructs a global spectral projection evolved by a NODE for canonical wave PDEs, whereas this candidate keeps a parameter-capped backbone and constructs a solver-floor residual-feasibility continuation plus same-coordinate causal-device falsification for coupled moving 2D VO2 fronts.

The adaptive-spectral study measures how initial-condition gates rescale gradients in a stiff 0D spring-pendulum ODE, while this candidate replaces the global coupled objective endpoint and measures event, topology, energy, and simultaneous-residual consequences in a spatial electro-thermal-phase device.

The energy-dissipation PINN simplifies dynamic phase evolution to an ill-posed static prediction with an added energy constraint, whereas this candidate retains transient propagation and constructs a continuation whose terminal object is simultaneous dynamic residual feasibility.

The VO2 study uses operando imaging and phase-field simulation to reveal electro-thermo-mechanical switching and period-doubling domains, while this candidate constructs and falsifies a PINN training mechanism across grouped synthetic devices and pulse protocols without claiming experimental validation.

what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to replace its fixed reconstructed-PDE aggregate with a solver-discretization-floor vector traversed by one explicit continuation coordinate and then show, on coupled 2D phase fronts, that the resulting closure margin predicts event, topology, and energy fidelity under a same-coordinate permutation control.
